basis: renders a <div role="group"> — a labelled container of the ruler and user-supplied time bars; the bars themselves are positioned divs the host labels with their own aria-label.

responsive.basis: geometry is percentage-based — bar position and width derive from the visible window alone, so the track scales trivially with any container width and has no viewport mechanism of its own; the harness specimen pins the proportions at one viewport.

harness.because: asserts bar proportion and aria-labels in browser, not the group's non-interactive matrix rows

exceptions.because: a track owns no focusable element — bars are positioned divs with aria-labels and the window is host state, so the row's traversal contract reduces to the host's own controls
the pattern renders no focusable element — bars are aria-labelled divs with no tabindex — so there is nothing to obscure

interaction.basis: a track is a container the host fills with its own bars; the bars are non-interactive geometry.

exceptions.because: the pattern ships no interactive element — zoom/pan is host-owned state the demo drives with plain buttons
